# DB Tools Create Table.vi

![DB Tools Create Table.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/DB-07.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Creates a new table in the database identified by connection reference . The table and column information inputs describe the name of the table and the properties of each column in the table, respectively.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

## IN — inputs

| Displayed terminal / internal ID | Accepted / resolved type | Studio connection | Unwired input default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| connection reference `connection_reference` | `ref<connectivity.database.connection>` | Required | Not specified | ADO Connection object used to identify the database connection. |
| table `table` | `string` | Required | Not specified | table is the name of the table in the database to create. |
| column information `column_information` | `unknown` | Recommended | Not specified | column information specifies an array of clusters that describe each column to be created. |
| error in `error_in` | `cluster<status:bool,code:i32,source:string>` | Recommended | `{status:false,code:0,source:""}` | Error state received from the preceding operation; the source value is the standard LabVIEW error cluster. |
